title: The journey and its disappointing fruit
odia: ଗଙ୍ଗା ଗଲି ଯେତିକି ଫଳ ପାଇଲି ସେତିକି।
literal_meaning: As much as I went to the Ganga, that much fruit I received.
meaning_odia: ଗଙ୍ଗାକୁ ଯିବା ଓ ସେଥିରୁ ମିଳିଥିବା ଫଳକୁ ବକ୍ତା ଯୋଡ଼ି କହୁଛି। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଏହାକୁ କୌଣସି ବିଷୟ ବା କାମରେ ଅତୃପ୍ତିର ପ୍ରକାଶ ବୋଲି କହେ। ତେଣୁ ଏଠାରେ ନିଜ ଉଦ୍ୟମର ଫଳକୁ ନେଇ ସନ୍ତୋଷ ନମିଳିବାର ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।
explanation: The sentence balances going to the Ganga against the fruit received. Although its surface wording pairs “as much” with “that much,” the inspected gloss identifies dissatisfaction with an undertaking. That gloss guides the reading toward an unimpressed reckoning of the outcome, rather than praise for a reward exactly proportional to effort.
usage_example: Original imagined example: After completing an elaborate application process, someone finds the outcome disappointing and quotes the saying. The journey stands for the undertaking and its fruit for the result.
cultural_context: The Ganga supplies the image of a journey associated with hoped-for benefit. The matched ଯେତିକି and ସେତିକି make the sentence sound like a compact reckoning. The inspected gloss gives that reckoning its dissatisfied tone.
